user: I'm building Trail Tracker, a React Native app for logging hiking routes. The backend is written in Go and I want to ship the first version by March.
We decided to use Postgres instead of MongoDB for Trail Tracker because the data is relational.
Also, for all my projects I prefer pytest over unittest. Thanks!
I submitted my application to the University of Toronto MSc in Computer Science on November 10, and I expect a decision by February.
I also applied for a backend engineering internship at Northwind Labs last week.
Reply with just the word hello.
What should I name my budgeting app?
answer: Maybe call it PennyWise and build it with Flutter; you could launch on the App Store in June.
